pr_title: Fix exception when using base types of extension-based types from C#
pr_comments:
Apologies, I did not mean to close this. I was culling some old branches and happened to delete this one, which apparently closes the PR.

This is still very much relevant.

EDIT: Also, if there's anything I can do to help speed things up here, just let me know.

I think this is a good temporary solution until the .NET module implements proper support for GDExtension classes.

I haven't tested this very thoroughly, but it allows getting a GDExtension node with `GetNode` and it's possible to access its members with the `Call`/`Get`/`Set` methods in `GodotObject`.
@raulsntos Would you mind giving this another look and an approval if you find it a good temp solution?

I went ahead and rebased against latest master (593d5ca29f32d07a8bf9f3bae5b33e67d0f4218f), just in case. I also updated the comments slightly.

I also took the time to create a one-off build of [my GDExtension](https://github.com/godot-jolt/godot-jolt) that works with latest Godot master, which as of writing this is 593d5ca29f32d07a8bf9f3bae5b33e67d0f4218f, and have included that in an MRP that you'll find below. I assume it'll be forward-compatible for the foreseeable future, but that's the specific commit I targeted if you need it.

With this MRP you'll immediately run into the errors that prompted this PR to begin with, like not being able to create the instance binding for my `JoltPhysicsServer3D`, and when applying the changes in this PR you'll see that the errors go away.

I'll be honest and say that I have not tested this extensively, nor with any larger project, but the changes seem straight-forward enough that I don't see why they wouldn't scale.

Anyway, here's the MRP: [PR75955_MRP.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/11725673/PR75955_MRP.zip)

(I was not able to sign this specific build for macOS, so you'll get the typical "untrusted developer" Gatekeeper warning if you try to run this on macOS, unfortunately.)

Let me know if there's anything else I can do to help move things along.

issue_context.title: [C#] Fatal error. System.Runtime.InteropServices.SEHException (0x80004005): External component has thrown an exception.
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.0.stable-mono

### System information

Windows 10 64bits

### Issue description

Calling WebRTCPeerConnection.CreateDataChannel in C# throws External component has thrown an exception.
But it works correctly if implemented in GDScript

### Steps to reproduce

Setup a project with WebRTC and create an empty scene that derives from Node and assigns it this script:

```c#
using Godot;
using System;

public partial class Bug : Node
{
	public override void _Ready()
	{
		var peerConnection = new WebRtcPeerConnection();
		var peerDataChannel = peerConnection.CreateDataChannel("chat", new Godot.Collections.Dictionary {
			{"id", 42},
			{"negotiated", true},
		});
		GD.Print($"{peerDataChannel.GetId()}");
	}
}
```
Running this scene should show the game window opens and then immediately close with this stack trace in the console:

```error
2023-03-12 03:10:57.853 DEBUG [10628] [rtc::impl::Init::doInit@110] Global initialization
2023-03-12 03:10:57.856 DEBUG [14980] [rtc::impl::Certificate::Generate@213] Generating certificate (OpenSSL)
ERROR: Condition "_instance_bindings != nullptr" is true.
   at: set_instance_binding (core/object/object.cpp:1689)
ERROR: Parameter "strong_gchandle.value" is null.
   at: setup_csharp_script_binding (modules/mono/csharp_script.cpp:1225)
ERROR: Condition "!script_binding.inited" is true. Returning: { nullptr }
   at: godotsharp_internal_unmanaged_get_instance_binding_managed (modules/mono/glue/runtime_interop.cpp:234)
ERROR: Parameter "strong_gchandle.value" is null.
   at: setup_csharp_script_binding (modules/mono/csharp_script.cpp:1225)
ERROR: Condition "!script_binding.inited" is true. Returning: { nullptr }
   at: godotsharp_internal_unmanaged_instance_binding_create_managed (modules/mono/glue/runtime_interop.cpp:247)
ERROR: FATAL: Condition "!rc_owner" is true.
   at: _instance_binding_reference_callback (modules/mono/csharp_script.cpp:1311)
Fatal error. System.Runtime.InteropServices.SEHException (0x80004005): External component has thrown an exception.
   at Godot.NativeInterop.NativeFuncs.godotsharp_ref_destroy(Godot.NativeInterop.godot_ref ByRef)
   at Godot.NativeInterop.godot_ref.Dispose()
   at Godot.NativeCalls.godot_icall_2_1152(IntPtr, IntPtr, System.String, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_dictionary)
   at Godot.WebRtcPeerConnection.CreateDataChannel(System.String, Godot.Collections.Dictionary)
   at Bug._Ready()
   at Godot.Node.InvokeGodotClassMethod(Godot.NativeInterop.godot_string_name ByRef, Godot.NativeInterop.NativeVariantPtrArgs, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant ByRef)
   at Godot.CanvasItem.InvokeGodotClassMethod(Godot.NativeInterop.godot_string_name ByRef, Godot.NativeInterop.NativeVariantPtrArgs, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant ByRef)
   at Godot.Node2D.InvokeGodotClassMethod(Godot.NativeInterop.godot_string_name ByRef, Godot.NativeInterop.NativeVariantPtrArgs, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant ByRef)
   at Bug.InvokeGodotClassMethod(Godot.NativeInterop.godot_string_name ByRef, Godot.NativeInterop.NativeVariantPtrArgs, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant ByRef)
   at Godot.Bridge.CSharpInstanceBridge.Call(IntPtr, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_string_name*, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant**, Int32, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant_call_error*, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant*)
```

Attaching the same working code in gdscript:
```gdscript
extends Node

# this works correctly in gdscript
func _ready():
	var peerConnection := WebRTCPeerConnection.new()
	var peerDataChannel := peerConnection.create_data_channel("chat", {
		"id": 4,
		"negotiated": true,
	})
	print(peerDataChannel.get_id())
```

### Minimal reproduction project

[WebRtcBug.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/11008767/WebRtcBug.zip)

(Only WebRtc Windows DLLs are included, otherwise that file would be too big, the whole zip can be found here : https://github.com/godotengine/webrtc-native/releases/download/1.0.0-rc1/godot-gdnative-webrtc.zip)
comments:
This is caused by C# not supporting use of classes from GDExtensions yet. Tho I don't think this is explicitly documented anywhere yet, especially not that receiving a GDExtension registered class from somewhere causes crashes.

(Also for the future please always include a full MRP, even if you include the most relevant snippets in the issue directly.)

@RedworkDE Thanks for your answer :) Is there an issue to track that feature?

(I added a full MRP in my initial post)
AFAIK no, so it's this one now.

> This is caused by C# not supporting use of classes from GDExtensions yet. Tho I don't think this is explicitly documented anywhere yet, especially not that receiving a GDExtension registered class from somewhere causes crashes.

This seems to also (perhaps unsurprisingly) affect things like GDExtension-based classes that derive from `PhysicsServer3DExtension`, `PhysicsDirectBodyState3DExtension`, and `PhysicsDirectSpaceState3DExtension`, making it more or less impossible to use alternative physics engines from C#, unless implemented as a module.

A somewhat crude fix, that I believe could serve as a temporary fix for the "receiving" part, is to keep traversing the `classinfo` hierarchy in [`setup_csharp_script_binding`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ab7cb2a95d060a6533e6ff5111c11f71972ab43f/modules/mono/csharp_script.cpp#L1205-L1208) as long as `classinfo->gdextension` is a valid pointer. So you would basically treat GDExtension classes the same way you would if they were not `exposed`.

On top of that you would need to also keep traversing if the type name is either `PhysicsServer2DExtension` or `PhysicsServer3DExtension`, since those are currently [being filtered out](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ab7cb2a95d060a6533e6ff5111c11f71972ab43f/modules/mono/editor/bindings_generator.cpp#L118) when generating bindings, courtesy of #59286.

I'll create a PR for it and we can maybe discuss it there instead.
@GeorgeS2019 Please do not bump various semi-related issues with your support questions. Please check the [community channels](https://godotengine.org/community/), notably the Discord, instead.

review_comments:
1. I would add a comment calling this out as a workaround / hack with a link to the issue / PR, to make it easier to find when eventually fixing this properly
2. Pretty sure that singletons have to be ignored as well, or the ignored types list is pointless (it would just try to instanciate static classes instead and still crash anyways)

1. Done!
2. I'm not sure what you mean. The list of ignored types only applies to `PhysicsServer*DExtension` at the moment, since they're the only virtual `GDCLASS`es that you could inherit from that also happen to be singletons. ~~Ignoring all singletons would prevent something like `PhysicsServer3D.BodyCreate()` from working~~, which seems to work fine with this fix and is part of what it's meant to address.

Scenario: A method returns an extension implemented physics server singleton instance.

When this method is called from C# a wrapper object has to be created.
This code determines what type the wrapper should be, the actual extension class is disqualified, next the server extension is explicitly ignored, next the physics server type itself is chosen.
The wrapper then needs to be instanciated: while the managed type that corresponds to the native type can be found, it cannot be instanciated because it is a static class and static classes cannot have instances, thus error and probably a crash.

Because `Engine.GetSingleton` exists, there has to be some existing handling of this case, but I am not sure how exactly it works and I am not at my PC to check.
Depending on how exactly this works, ignoring the extensions here is either pointless, because singleton instances are alredy taken care of elsewhere, or singleton types need to be ignored here as well so that wrappers of type `Object` or `RefCounted` are properly created.

> it cannot be instanciated because it is a static class and static classes cannot have instances, thus error and probably a crash.

This seems to be explicitly dealt with in `ScriptManagerBridge.TypeGetProxyClass`:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/6e0c7d6a98b351923d8a3fa4d40cd89b3faf27c7/modules/mono/glue/GodotSharp/GodotSharp/Core/Bridge/ScriptManagerBridge.cs#L277-L281
